title: helm(private): validate values schema + init-job hooks for upgrade/rollback stability
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) have seen intermittent upgrade/rollback failures around init values and helm hooks when CRDs and data migrations race with application startup. This PR introduces a stricter values schema, guardrails in templating, and converts the previous ad-hoc initJob into idempotent Helm hooks (pre-install, pre-upgrade, post-upgrade) with explicit retry behavior. The goal is to make upgrades and rollbacks deterministic and provide clearer validation errors at chart install time. Changes included: 1) values.schema.json: complete JSONSchema for the chart's private-specific values (networking, storage, initJobs, tolerations, affinity, k8sVersion constraints). 2) Chart templating updates: add fail-fast validations, use required/with checks and clearer error messages. 3) templates/init-job.yaml: refactor into a Hook with hook-weight and hook-delete-policy, make job idempotent via a ConfigMap-based token lock. 4) templates/crd-hooks.yaml: ensure CRDs are installed/updated via pre-install hook and do not block upgrades when unchanged. 5) templates/_helpers.tpl: expose validation helpers and standardized name helpers. 6) tests/upgrade-rollback.sh and CI matrix: add helm upgrade/rollback scenarios, simulate partial failures and verify hook idempotency. 7) README and docs: document values schema and common upgrade troubleshooting steps. Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json added and wired into Chart.yaml - [x] initJob converted to Helm hooks with delete policy - [x] idempotency token implemented and tested locally - [x] CI integration tests added to validate upgrade/rollback matrix - [x] docs updated and changelog entry added Known limitations: - Schema does not validate cluster-level RBAC resources; installer still requires cluster-admin for CRD installs. - Edge-case: extremely short helm timeout will still fail; recommend chart default timeout increase in release notes. Please review the hook semantics and the idempotency approach (ConfigMap token + job owner references).
commits_summary: 3 commits: validate-values-schema (adds JSONSchema + Helm template validation), init-hooks-refactor (convert init job to pre-install/post-upgrade Hook with idempotency), rollback-fix (improve upgrade/rollback tolerations and CRD requeue).
review_conversation: Aisha: Left small comments on the ConfigMap lock TTL and race window; suggested adding ownerReferences to the job for cleanup. Marcus: Asked for stronger validation error messages when a required values block is missing; I updated templates with explicit 'required' messages. Liam: Requested a test that simulates partial CRD apply failure; added a CI job that intentionally fails CRD apply on first attempt and ensures post-upgrade hook re-runs and completes. CI flakiness: initial CI run had a flaky e2e due to cluster quota; reran pipeline and all checks passed. Final approval from Aisha and Marcus before squash-merge.
release_notes: Private Helm chart: validate values via schema on install/upgrade; convert init job to idempotent Helm hooks to improve upgrade/rollback stability; add upgrade/rollback CI tests and troubleshooting docs. Users should review chart timeout and RBAC notes before upgrading.
testing_notes: Added deterministic CI scenarios: helm install->upgrade with CRD change, helm upgrade->rollback when init hook fails, and repeated upgrades to validate idempotency. Local tests exercised by author on KinD and on a staging EKS cluster. Tests added in tests/upgrade-rollback.sh and integrated into ci/helm-matrix.yml.
security_implications: No new privileges introduced; hooks run as existing service account. CRD hook requires cluster-admin in installer flow (unchanged behavior). Documented in docs/upgrade-troubleshooting.md.
impact_summary: Stabilizes Private chart upgrades, reduces rollback-induced downtime, provides clearer validation errors on bad values, and adds CI coverage to detect regressions. Backwards compatible with existing values; schema is additive and permissive where needed.
notes_for_operations: Operators should note default Helm timeout increased to 10m for chart operations in this release and validate RBAC for CRD install step. If using locked images, ensure imagePullPolicy matches cluster policy.
